observations: All 24 Dark figure proofs preserve the captured source appearance; captions and panel labels use the Dark reader foreground with transparent figure framing.
No clipping, overlapping caption, distorted aspect ratio, source-color inversion, stretched small detail, or unrelated private text was observed.
The 147 by 50 pixel Copied panel remains at native size on desktop and fits the mobile article. The retry message and retained caption are separate focused panels.

At 390 CSS pixels, wide overview, import-completion, destination, usage-guidance and handoff screenshots contain microtext that is too small to read fully in the inline overview. Focused panels, explanatory captions and visible larger-image links provide the reading path; the review does not claim all overview microtext is legible inline.
Figma component identity, primary-action value 48, four Review values, and Edit/Back actions are retained by the focused panels and captions.

normalViewportReview.harnessCorrection: Read selected aria state after the menu closed using the non-visible locator; scroll lazy images into view before awaiting decode.
